name: 公众号排版引擎
description_zh: 微信公众号文章排版引擎，将 Markdown / Word / PDF / 纯文本一键转换为可直接复制粘贴到公众号编辑器且样式不丢失的 HTML。内置多套主题组件库（摸鱼绿、只此青绿、留白禅意、石墨极简等），支持自动章节编号、关键词下划线、引言卡片、目录导航、代码块、图片、作者签名；也支持按参考图或描述生成自定义主题组件库本地复用。
description_en: A WeChat Official Account article typesetting engine that converts Markdown / Word / PDF / plain text into copy-paste-ready, style-preserving HTML for the WeChat editor. Ships with multiple theme component libraries (Moyu Green, Zhici Qinglv, Zen Whitespace, Graphite Minimal, etc.), automatic section numbering, keyword underlines, quote cards, TOC navigation, code blocks, images and author signatures. Also generates custom theme libraries from reference images or descriptions for local reuse.
